context_pill: Income Tax Act | Section 4 & 5 | Diversion vs Application of Income
example_summary: MKG Agency paid ₹ 1 lakh (20% of profit) to the mother of partners under a mandatory partnership deed clause after father's death. The payment constitutes a diversion of income by overriding title at source and is excluded from the firm's total income.
source_provision:
| Feature / Criterion | Diversion of Income by Overriding Title | Application of Income |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Timing of Obligation** | Charge or obligation attached **prior** to or at the source of receipt | Obligation arises **after** income accrues or is received by assessee |
| **Nature of Title** | Recipient has a **superior title** created by law or legal instrument | Assessee receives income in own right, then applies it |
| **Taxability / Treatment** | **Excluded** from Total Income (Not taxable in hands of assessee) | **Included** in Total Income (Taxable; no general deduction allowed) |
| **Judicial Precedent** | *CIT v. Sitaldas Tirathdas (1961) 41 ITR 367 (SC)* | *CIT v. Sitaldas Tirathdas (1961) 41 ITR 367 (SC)* |


### Statutory & Judicial Benchmarks

* **The Benchmark Test (Supreme Court Rule):** The true test is whether the amount sought to be deducted is an allocation of income after it has accrued, or whether it is an obligation to apply income which has accrued, or whether it is a charge on the income before it reaches the assessee.
* **Partnership Deed Stipulations:** Where a reconstituted firm pays a specified share of profit to a deceased partner's beneficiary pursuant to an imperative clause in the Partnership Deed creating an overriding charge, the payment constitutes diversion at source (*CIT v. Nariman B. Bharucha & Sons*).


> [!IMPORTANT] Overriding Title vs Contractual Expense
> Diversion by overriding title requires a legal obligation created by law, decree, or instrument that diverts the income at source before it accrues to or is received by the assessee.

director.justification: The core tax question requires evaluating whether payment of 20% profits to a partner's widow constitutes a diversion of income at source by overriding title or a taxable application of income.
director.visual_metaphor: A river stream diverted at source into a separate canal before reaching the firm's reservoir

beats.voice_sync_text: Income Tax Act-ന്റെ Section 4, Section 5 എന്നിവ അടിസ്ഥാനമാക്കി ഇവിടുത്തെ കാര്യങ്ങൾ പഠിക്കുമ്പോൾ, Diversion of Income by Overriding Title-ൽ income accrue ചെയ്യുന്നതിന് മുമ്പ് superior title ഉള്ളയാൾക്ക് ലഭിക്കുന്നു, ഇത് Total Income-ൽ നിന്ന് exclude ചെയ്യാം. എന്നാൽ Application of Income-ൽ തുക ആദ്യം assessee-ക്ക് ലഭിച്ച ശേഷമാണ് spend ചെയ്യുന്നത്, അതിനാൽ taxable ആണ്.
